editorial.blurb: Beity brings authentic Lebanese cuisine to the West Loop with modern refinement, where standout dishes like perfectly executed hummus and crispy whole chicken shine alongside thoughtful service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the 'eat the Lebanese way' option for exclusive dishes not available a la carte, though it's generous; alternatively, go for the tasting menu and don't hesitate to ask the chef for off-menu tastings like the lamb dumplings.

topDishes.note: Crispy outside, moist inside; best with pita and toum
Perfect consistency and flavor, nailed the balance
